title: Der Lauf der Dinge (transitionend)
summary: A chain reaction where each object moves only because the previous one's transition finished — causality as the browser's own event.
mechanism: DOM transitionend events chain one CSS transform transition to the next, so completion is the literal cause of the following motion; per-visit Math.random re-throws geometry and timing, RAM only.
references: Peter Fischli & David Weiss, Der Lauf der Dinge / The Way Things Go (1987)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
